title: List of HN Group companies
---
{{Short description|List of the companies in HN Group}}
This is a list of the companies in '''[[HN Group]]'''. HN Group has three direct, wholly owned subsidiaries: [[Horizon Network]], [[Horizon Media Group]] and [[Horizon Assets Management]]. [[Horizon Development]] is part of Horizon Network; [[Horizon Advertising]] is a subsidiary of Horizon Media Group and is managed by Horizon Network.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/companies Our companies], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>
